title.rendered: NoMa Farmers Market At Third Street

content.rendered:
Join friends and neighbors from April 30-October 29, 2026 to shop for fresh produce, farm-raised meats, cheeses, freshly baked goods, and dozens more unique, locally made foods and goods.


Join the NoMa BID at the NoMa Farmers Market from April 30 – October 29 on Thursdays from 4:00 – 8:00 p.m., located on Third Street NE, where you’ll find fresh produce, quality meats, and artisanal goods. Grab ready-to-eat meals and treats while enjoying live music and outdoor seating. Conveniently located near the NoMa-Gallaudet Metro and Union Market, it’s perfect for evening commuters and locals alike!
